column1: # Each operation's peak resident set, held by peak_memory.rs.
# Three tab-separated fields: build, case, bytes.
#   build   default or bundled-fonts, the build the figure was read in
#   case    one of the probe's seven, as CASES in peak_memory.rs names it
#   bytes   the child's VmHWM, in bytes
# A run holds each case to its build's figure plus 2 % and fails a case with
# no line here. `unheld` in place of the bytes measures and prints the case and
# holds it to nothing (H-78). `TINKER_PEAK_RECORD=1` prints each case's line in
# this form instead of holding it.
# Read on the hosted Linux image from the `peak-memory` jobs of CI runs
# `develop`, 6 November 2026: each figure is the larger of its case's two
# peaks, and the spread between the two, larger over smaller less one, is
# png-20-on-4, twenty pages rendered on four threads, read 82 636 800 and
# 98 439 168 bytes in the default build and 88 715 264 and 77 705 216 with the
# bundled faces, a spread of 19.1 % and 14.2 %: its peak moves with how the
# pages are scheduled, so it is held to nothing until MS-25 makes it steady.
